# Overview
High-level project grounding for review. This section maps the `gitboard` product landscape for agentic interaction, focusing on its role as a local code-change dashboard for GitLab and GitHub.
## Product Grounding
`gitboard` provides visibility into CI status, open Merge Requests, failed job triage, and local worktree states by interfacing with `gh`, `glab`, and `git`. It operates as a local service, typically served via `gitboard serve`.
### Slice Objective Ledger (Inferred)
The system is organized into functional slices that manage the lifecycle of repository observation and local synchronization:
Observation & Triage: `internal/triage` and `internal/dashboard` manage the presentation of CI status and job failures.
Remote Integration: `internal/remotegit` and `internal/syncproj` handle the interaction with GitLab and GitHub forge APIs.
Local State: `internal/localgit` and `internal/cliexec` manage the local git environment and CLI tool execution.
Core Services: `internal/server`, `internal/config`, and `internal/board` provide the orchestration and configuration layer.
### Typology Catalog
The following package categories define the operational capabilities of the `gitboard` ecosystem:
Interface: `internal/dashboard`, `internal/server` (Provides the user-facing web interface and API).
Execution: `internal/cliexec`, `internal/localgit` (Manages local machine tool invocation and git state).
Synchronization: `internal/remotegit`, `internal/syncproj` (Bridges remote forge data to the local board).
Intelligence: `internal/llm`, `internal/pruneagent` (Supports automated triage and agentic processing of repository changes).
